name: Entity reference autocomplete FormElement with add more
description: Registers a Form API render element that adds an entity-reference autocomplete input with AJAX "Add another item" / "Remove" buttons, for use in any custom form.
project_description: A developer-only module that registers a single Form API render element, entity_reference_autocomplete_add_more (class Drupal\entity_reference_autocomplete_add_more\Element\EntityReferenceAutocompleteAddMore). Core's entity_reference_autocomplete widget requires a field storage attached to an entity, so it works only on entity forms; this element is a lightweight alternative usable on any custom form (settings forms, custom action forms, config forms) with no field storage. Each item is a core entity_autocomplete input, and the element adds AJAX "Add another item" and per-item "Remove" buttons that grow or shrink the list of references without a page reload. It ships no admin UI, no configuration, no routes, no permissions and no dependencies beyond Drupal core; it is consumed only from custom form-building code. Works on Drupal 10 and 11.
